INFERNUX / RELEASES

Built release by release.

New capabilities, fixes and upgrade notes. Read the complete history of Infernux, in English and Chinese.

  1. v0.4.3-v62026-10-25

    Hotfix 6: Portable Plugin Updates

    This hotfix repairs plugin updates after cloning or moving a project to a machine with an empty package cache. It also fixes default MCP updates that could prevent an existing project from opening after an engine hotfix upgrade. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 6, with the matching Hub bundle at 0.4.3-7.

    Read full changelog →
  2. v0.4.3-v52026-10-24

    Hotfix 5: Game Input and Preview Control

    This hotfix repairs game UI input in the editor and restores control of the Game preview resolution. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 5, with the matching Hub bundle at 0.4.3-6.

    Read full changelog →
  3. v0.4.3-v42026-10-23

    Hotfix 4: Character Geometry and Color Composition

    This hotfix completes the native text interfaces used by the independent animation plugins. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 4, with the matching Hub bundle at 0.4.3-5.

    Read full changelog →
  4. v0.4.3-v32026-10-23

    Hotfix 3: Reliable Plugin Reload and Text Authoring

    This hotfix fixes issues found while using independently installed animation plugins in real Windows and Linux projects. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 3. Hub 0.4.3-4 accompanies this distribution without changing its project-update workflow.

    Read full changelog →
  5. v0.4.3-v22026-10-22

    Hotfix 2: Native Text and Plugin Foundations

    This 0.4.3 hotfix adds reusable native text-animation and plugin-update interfaces, and repairs clocks and rendering state found during cross-platform validation. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; the engine uses build 2, with the separate Hub update at 0.4.3-3.

    Read full changelog →
  6. v0.4.32026-10-20

    Faster Frames, Complete Players

    0.4.3 brings the editor, animation authoring and cross-platform Players through a sustained real-game validation cycle. The focus is a correct, efficient main path: less repeated frame work, complete startup preparation, consistent asset identities and usable editing tools.

    Read full changelog →
  7. v0.4.22026-10-13

    Reliable Worlds and Collaborative Authoring

    0.4.2 strengthens the working paths introduced in 0.4.1: portable projects, stable asset identities, transactional editing, script reload, physics, rendering and delivery. This release brings the repair and acceptance work into the published engine, refreshes the website, and ships matching platform packages.

    Read full changelog →
  8. v0.4.12026-10-01

    Worlds, Compute and Live Tools

    0.4.1 brings larger worlds, live Python authoring and target-aware computation into the same engine workflow. This release expands multi-scene editing, prefab authoring, model import, rendering and audio, then carries their resource and component lifecycles into exported Players. It also rebuilds key parts of the plugin experience in response to community reports.

    Read full changelog →
  9. v0.4.02026-09-06

    Multiplatform Builds and Distribution

    0.4.0 adds Windows, Linux, Android, and Web Player builds, expands InxPackage authoring and runtime asset delivery, and puts shared build environments under Hub management.

    Read full changelog →
  10. v0.3.72026-08-27

    Plugins and Skeletal Animation

    0.3.7 adds the InxPackage plugin system, moves MCP out of the engine core, and fixes skeletal animation imported from separate FBX files.

    Read full changelog →
  11. v0.3.62026-08-24

    Unified Hierarchy and Hub Updates

    Version 0.3.6 unifies the editor Hierarchy and restores automatic update discovery for packaged Infernux Hub builds.

    Read full changelog →

    Release notes

    Original GitHub release notes, preserved as published.

INFERNUX / RELEASES

记录引擎的每一次成长。

新能力、问题修复与升级须知。在这里查看 Infernux 每一期的完整变化。

  1. v0.4.3-v62026-10-25

    热修 6：可迁移的插件更新

    本次热修修复项目克隆、迁移到空插件缓存的设备后无法正确更新插件的问题，也修复更新引擎热修时，默认 MCP 更新误报本地修改、导致旧项目无法打开的问题。引擎基础版本保持 0.4.3，wheel 使用构建号 6，配套 Hub 为 0.4.3-7。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  2. v0.4.3-v52026-10-24

    热修 5：游戏输入与预览控制

    本次热修修复编辑器中的游戏 UI 输入，并恢复 Game 预览分辨率的选择权。引擎基础版本保持 0.4.3，wheel 使用构建号 5，配套 Hub 为 0.4.3-6。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  3. v0.4.3-v42026-10-23

    热修 4：字符几何与颜色组合

    本次热修补齐独立动画插件使用的原生文本接口。引擎基础版本保持 0.4.3，wheel 使用构建号 4，配套 Hub 为 0.4.3-5。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  4. v0.4.3-v32026-10-23

    热修 3：插件重载与文字创作修复

    本次热修解决独立安装的动画插件在 Windows、Linux 真实项目中暴露的问题。引擎基础版本保持 0.4.3，wheel 使用构建号 3；配套 Hub 0.4.3-4 保持原有项目更新流程。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  5. v0.4.3-v22026-10-22

    热修 2：原生文字与插件基础能力

    本次 0.4.3 热修补齐可复用的原生文字动画、插件更新阶段与编辑预览接口，并修复跨平台验证中发现的时钟和渲染状态问题。引擎基础版本仍为 0.4.3，引擎使用构建号 2，独立的 Hub 更新为 0.4.3-3。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  6. v0.4.32026-10-20

    更快的帧循环，更完整的跨平台交付

    0.4.3 将持续的实际游戏验证带回编辑器、动画工具与各平台 Player。重点是让主路径本身正确、高效：减少逐帧重复工作，在进入游戏前完成必要准备，保持资产身份一致，并修复实际创作中的工具问题。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  7. v0.4.22026-10-13

    稳定的世界与协作创作

    0.4.2 强化了 0.4.1 建立的工作主路径：可迁移项目、稳定资源身份、事务式编辑、脚本重载、物理、渲染与交付。本期将修复和验收工作纳入正式发布的引擎，更新网站，并提供匹配的新平台插件。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  8. v0.4.12026-10-01

    世界、计算与实时创作工具

    0.4.1 把更大的世界、实时 Python 创作与面向目标平台的计算带进同一套引擎工作流。本期扩展了多场景、Prefab、模型导入、渲染和音频能力，并把资源与组件的生命周期贯通到导出的 Player；同时根据社区反馈，完善了插件开发和热重载的关键环节。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  9. v0.4.02026-09-06

    多平台构建与分发

    0.4.0 加入 Windows、Linux、Android 和 Web Player 构建，完善 InxPackage 创作与运行时资产分发，并将共享构建环境交给 Hub 管理。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  10. v0.3.72026-08-27

    插件系统与骨骼动画

    0.3.7 加入 InxPackage 插件系统，把 MCP 从引擎核心中拆出，并修复从独立 FBX 文件导入的骨骼动画。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
  11. v0.3.62026-08-24

    统一 Hierarchy 与 Hub 更新

    0.3.6 统一了编辑器 Hierarchy，并恢复打包版 Infernux Hub 的自动更新发现能力。

    阅读完整更新日志 →
